name: EPGForgearr
description: Supplemental XMLTV EPG generator for Dispatcharr. Workflow: scan missing EPG, review suggestions, generate XMLTV, install Dispatcharr EPG source.
author: Mildman1848

fields.label: Minimum suggestion confidence
fields.help_text: Use low only for review reports. Low confidence is not safe for automatic activation.

fields.label: Also scan channels that already have EPG
fields.help_text: Normally off: supplemental EPG should target gaps first.

fields.label: Auto-select safe-looking suggestions
fields.help_text: Leave off for real use. Suggestions are review material; variants can look deceptively exact.

fields.label: Daily auto-refresh
fields.help_text: Daily auto-refresh for selected EPG sources (Celery worker self-scheduler).

actions.label: Scan missing EPG
actions.description: Scan linked Dispatcharr channels using selected provider sources and write reviewable suggestions.

actions.label: Install sources
actions.description: Create or update Dispatcharr EPG sources for selected providers using their existing generated XMLTV files.

actions.label: Generate EPG for sources
actions.description: Generate XMLTV files for selected provider sources without installing or refreshing Dispatcharr EPG sources.

actions.label: Install sources and generate EPG
actions.description: Generate XMLTV files and create or update Dispatcharr EPG sources for selected providers.
